image_license: UNKNOWN (no licence statement on object page)

museum: Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle (MNHN), Reptiles & Amphibians collection
museum_original_name: Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle, collection Reptiles et Amphibiens (RA), Paris
possible_additional_holdings: Other MNHN collections (Anatomie comparée, older Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire / Expédition d'Égypte material) not checked because science.mnhn.fr returns Cloudflare 403; GBIF RA dataset shows 13 Egyptian crocodile lots with sepulchral localities (Thèbes, Samoun, Kom Ombo).
scholarly_catalogue: Hekkala et al. 2011 (Molecular Ecology) and 2022 (Bull. Peabody Mus. Nat. Hist. 63(1):3-14)
image_license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (photos Laure Pierre, per GBIF media records)
notes: science.mnhn.fr item pages and mediaphoto.mnhn.fr return 403 (Cloudflare); images viewed via GBIF image cache. Specimen photos show original labels: 'Momies des sépultures de Communbo' (Chantre) and 'Momies de jeunes Crocodiles (de la Grotte de Samoun) Égypte par M. Gervais'.

museum_original_name: Musée des Confluences (ex-Muséum d'histoire naturelle de Lyon; Lortet & Gaillard animal mummy collection)
stated_count: UNKNOWN (crocodile-specific count not stated; portal search 'crocodile' 2026-09-24 yields 297 Egyptian crocodile mummy/part records: 197 'Bébé crocodile momifié', 25 'Momie de crocodile', 18 'Momie de jeune crocodile', 22 'amas de bébés crocodiles', heads/skulls/fragments/tail/leg/teeth, 2 eggs, 1 embryo, 1 'simulacre')
stated_count_source: Official page museedesconfluences.fr/fr/le-musee/actualites/la-collection-de-momies-animales-egypte (24 Jan 2024): 'près de 2 500 momies animales' in total, crocodiles among species
possible_additional_holdings: Nicolotti & Robert 1994 catalogue 'Les crocodiles momifiés du muséum de Lyon' (not accessible, Persée PDF blocked) may list items not titled with 'crocodile' online; Lortet & Gaillard 1903-1909 publications.
scholarly_catalogue: Lortet & Gaillard, La faune momifiée de l'ancienne Égypte (Archives du Muséum d'histoire naturelle de Lyon 8-10, 1903-1909); Nicolotti & Robert 1994, Nouv. Arch. Mus. Hist. Nat. Lyon 32: 4-62
image_license: Photos © Musée des Confluences (photographers named per record); portal: download for private, non-commercial use without modification; portal links CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
notes: Only 36 of 297 crocodile records have an online photo. Crocodile mummies from Kom Ombo (Lortet excavations 1907), Esna (Maspero gift 1900/1901), Roda, Saqqara (teeth). MAHES programme (Porcier et al.) studies the collection.
